threads.title: Australia's intergenerational tax reform package
threads.narrative: From Treasurer Chalmers' March framing through the May budget package to lower-house passage in June — the most concrete intergenerational-equity fiscal reform in any OECD country in 2026.

threads.title: Lighthiser v. Trump youth climate litigation
threads.narrative: 22 youth plaintiffs challenge Trump fossil-fuel executive orders; Ninth Circuit oral arguments in April end in unanimous dismissal in June, deepening the US federal judicial barrier to youth climate claims.

threads.title: EU Strategy on Intergenerational Fairness: institutional journey
threads.narrative: The first supranational intergenerational fairness framework moves from Commission adoption (March) through EESC hearings and GAC briefing to first-ever Council conclusions (May), drawing serious intellectual critique by June.

threads.title: ICJ climate advisory opinion: follow-through
threads.narrative: The downstream consequences of the July 2025 ICJ advisory opinion: UNGA endorsement (141-8) and the Right Livelihood Award for PISFCC, the youth movement that started it.

threads.title: Loss and Damage Fund: first delivery cycle
threads.narrative: The Fund for responding to Loss and Damage moves from youth demands and a thin pledge base through a country-support window and a closed first BIM call, then defers first project approvals to December 2026 — the operational test of whether locked-in climate harm gets grants this decade.

threads.title: Votes at 16: consultation demand to UK bill
threads.narrative: EU Youth Dialogue respondents put votes at 16 at the centre of Youth Goal #1; the UK Representation of the People Bill then carries the first UK-wide franchise extension in nearly 60 years toward the 2029 election.

threads.title: New Zealand climate tort override vs Smith rights appeal
threads.narrative: Wellington legislates to bar emissions-damage torts after Smith v Fonterra, while the Supreme Court separately lists a three-day NZBORA/Treaty climate-rights appeal that the tort ban cannot extinguish.

threads.title: US companion-bot child-safety statutes
threads.narrative: Oregon, Nebraska, and Connecticut enact companion or conversational-AI rules in one session: private right of action, bans on romantic role-play and variable rewards, and hourly minor disclosures — treating emotional AI as childhood infrastructure.

threads.title: UN Future Generations Envoy on hold; US names its own
threads.narrative: Pact paragraph 32(a) keeps the UN Special Envoy for Future Generations unfunded during UN80, while Washington appoints a national Special Envoy for Best Future Generations — multilateral stall against a branded national office.
